name: 食堂の受付締切と受取方法を確認する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE compact Japanese Lighthouse restaurant deadline/pickup card LH19-0014, pure white canvas, modest margins, complete portrait card.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL DoorDash source has highest priority for heart outline, filled rating star, small outline clock glyph geometry/proportion/stroke, fine control anatomy, alignment and spacing. Use top OPEN restaurant only. Image2 EXACT ORIGINAL pepperoni-pizza photograph: preserve actual pizza, pepperoni arrangement, crop and colors, reuse SAME image three times as source, do not invent different pizzas. Image3 Japanese mock is SECONDARY copy/layout, restore source details it omitted. Image4 approved Lighthouse style only: white rounded cards, subtle neutral boundary/soft shadow, forest-green gradient primary action.
Header 「ライトハウス食堂」 bold with ORIGINAL unselected outline HEART at trailing right (missing in mock, restore). Rating source star and exact text 「4.5（4千件以上の評価）」. Next source outline CLOCK plus status 「受付中」 in forest green and 「・21:40まで受付」 in neutral ink, not disabled or closed.
Three equal photo columns with same original pizza crop and exact captions: 「小（9インチ）」「中サイズ」「大（14インチ）」. Do not invent medium inch size, price or menu name. Preserve compact balanced spacing.
Bottom two available actions: outlined white 「配達」; primary forest-green gradient 「受け取り・約12分」. Keep source native rounded control anatomy, legible white label on green #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, restrained highlight/shadow. No extra icons/rows, no fees, travel time, price, map, navbar or second restaurant.
Typography LOCKED Meiryo headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0 at logical phone scale, existing compact roles and wrapping. Supporting icons slate #526173, main ink #1D1D1D, secondary #6E6E6E; status green meaningful and accompanied by text. Do not copy out-of-scope red CLOSED status. White background/card, fine neutral boundaries, restrained elevation, modest rounded corners, no broad mint, arbitrary colors, gloss, clipping or watermark.
reviewNotes: 原本・ピザ切抜き・日本語モック・独立編集を実見。原本優先でheart/star/clockを復元、4.5（4千件以上の評価）・受付中21:40まで・3サイズ・受取約12分・2操作と日本語の欠けなしを確認。同一写真の構成を3枠に保持し、中サイズの不明インチは補完せず。受付は緑の意味色、主要受取は森林色、補助アイコンはスレート。画素／フォント数値厳密一致・実時間営業情報・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
